Third-party code compiled into sunshine.exe by this fork
========================================================

SudoVDA driver interface header (sudovda-ioctl.h)
-------------------------------------------------
Used by: sunshine.exe, to talk to the SudoVDA virtual display driver
Author:  SudoMaker
Source:  https://github.com/SudoMaker/SudoVDA
         Common/Include/sudovda-ioctl.h at a4b09fa2aa731a964d0cb5d139cb1e6240e4da12
Change:  a newline added at the end of the file, nothing else

The SudoVDA repository has no licence file. Its README states:

MIT and CC0 or Public Domain (for changes I made, please consult Microsoft for their license), choose the least restrictive option.

This file is installed with Sunshine whether or not the driver is. The driver
itself is a separate, optional part of the AMD64 installer; when it is
installed, its own notices are in drivers\sudovda\THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt.
